Hi Alex —

Thanks again for speaking with us yesterday. As discussed, I’m sending the take-home exercise and the details for the async submission window. Please find the quick instructions below and the kit attached.

What we expect
- Implement the core endpoint described in the spec and include a short README explaining any trade-offs.
- Keep it to a maximum of 3 hours of focused work; partial solutions are fine.
- Submit a zip containing code, README, and any small supporting artifacts.

Important dates
- Released: 2027-04-01 09:00 PT
- Submission deadline: 2027-04-03 12:00 PT

Attachments:
- async-kit.pdf (problem statement + tests)

Review process
- We’ll run quick automated checks and then two engineers will do a peer review using our rubric. Marissa will post the reviewer rotation.

If anything is unclear, reply here or use the talent@acme-hq.com alias to loop in your recruiter.

Best of luck — looking forward to seeing your work.

Sean Gallagher

Alex —

Short answer: third-party libraries are fine as long as you note them in the README and they’re installable via pip. The harness will run in a sandbox with a 90s per-test timeout; we mention time limits in the kit under "evaluation".

Marissa — can you slot the reviewers and confirm windows? Priyom and Lauren are our usual pair for this role but feel free to shuffle if scheduling conflicts come up.

Sean
